# JustVoice's client API fixtures

Copied from JustVoice `server/tests/fixtures/client-api/` as of its commit 29eb8380 (2026-11-08; main at 3d5b2020 then), where its own
contract test (`server/tests/client_api.test.js`) holds its server to them; the shapes are written down in JustVoice
`docs/dev/client-api.md`. JustDirect's client test (`../../justvoice.test.js`) answers with them, so a change on
either side shows as a failing test on one of the two. When JustVoice changes its client API, copy them again from
its commit that changed them and say which here.
